description: The suffix has two empty derivations, but the restoration reads none of them, and the written route cannot use an empty suffix after a synthetic. So the restored omission has one derivation, and the check passes (engine §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text a | b
%rule a A [T suffix]
%rule b A [T suffix] [T suffix]
%rule suffix ε | empty
%rule empty ε
